name: Pembrolizumab Monotherapy, PD-L1 TPS >= 50% (KEYNOTE-024, NSCLC)

biomarkers.PD_L1: TPS >= 50% (tumor proportion score at least 50%) - required
biomarkers.note: First-line single-agent pembrolizumab requires PD-L1 tumor proportion score (TPS) >= 50% and absence of a sensitizing EGFR mutation or ALK rearrangement (and no other actionable driver directing targeted therapy). PD-L1 IHC testing (category 1) is recommended before first-line treatment in all metastatic NSCLC. PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor contraindications must be excluded. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, First-Line Monotherapy (KEYNOTE-024); DeVita 12th ed.

lineOfTherapy: first-line for metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 TPS >= 50%, EGFR/ALK wild-type

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 30: pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks (KEYNOTE-024, line 70724); flat dose 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks, given for up to 2 years (line 233347 to 233348)

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. line 70724 (KEYNOTE-024: pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks) and line 233347 to 233348 (flat 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks, up to 2 years). Single agent, Day 1 of a 21-day cycle. Alternative schedule: 400 mg IV every 6 weeks.

regimen.cycles: Pembrolizumab 200 mg every 21 days, continued until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity, up to 2 years (DeVita line 233348). Alternative schedule: 400 mg every 6 weeks.
supportiveCare: immune-related adverse event monitoring for pembrolizumab (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary/pneumonitis, colitis, endocrinopathies, myocarditis)
no cytotoxic premedication required for single-agent pembrolizumab

monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) before each cycle
clinical response and toxicity assessment each cycle

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; discontinue for severe or life-threatening pneumonitis or myocarditis; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for first-line single-agent pembrolizumab in metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 TPS >= 50% (KEYNOTE-024). Dose is grounded: Pembrolizumab 200 mg Day 1 every 3 weeks (or 400 mg every 6 weeks), continued up to 2 years, per DeVita 12th ed. lines 70724 and 233347 to 233348. Requires PD-L1 TPS >= 50% and EGFR/ALK wild-type (no actionable driver); Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026 MS-54 to MS-55 make single-agent pembrolizumab a category 1 preferred first-line option in this population and recommend PD-L1 IHC (category 1) before first-line therapy. Immune-related adverse-event monitoring, including discontinuation for severe pneumonitis or myocarditis, is captured. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
